newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group raises stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group raises stake in unit.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said on Tuesday it has acquired an additional 5.5 percent stake in Berjaya Capital Bhd for 105.8 million ringgit or an average cost of 3.42 ringgit per Berjaya Capital share.

In a statement, Berjaya Group said the 30.9 million Berjaya Capital shares were purchased in the open market between January 2 and February 3. With the purchase, Berjaya Group said it now owns 65.07 percent of Berjaya Capital, a company involved in general insurance, hire purchase and leasing.
Berjaya Group said the acquisition was financed through internally generated funds and borrowings.
The purchase was consistent with the group's policy to increase its shareholdings in its subsidiaries when such shares were available at attractive prices, it said.
Berjaya Capital stock closed at 3.40 ringgit on Tuesday.
